cohort: 352 pregnant women presenting to the Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital for delivery
finding: There was a significant association between maternal and newborn hemoglobin, with each 1-point decrease in maternal hemoglobin being associated with a 0.14-point decrease in umbilical cord hemoglobin.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a 0.46-point lower umbilical cord hemoglobin level compared with vaginal delivery.
